name: Email Batching
title: Check email at two or three set times per day.
subtitle: Communication Boundary
rationale: Scheduled windows turn email from an ambient interrupt stream into a bounded task with a start and an end.

evidence.summary: A randomized trial found checking email three times daily reduced stress versus unlimited checking; interruption research supports the mechanism.

indications: The inbox stays open in a visible tab all day.
Email checks exceed ten per day.
Replies interrupt focus blocks within minutes of arriving.
